# The scored set's sources: one `id url` per line, `#` comments allowed.
#
# `make enrich-record` captures each page through Harbor's own fetch and extract
# and writes testdata/saves/<id>.json. `labels.json` is the owner's file: it
# gets a blank entry for every capture and is never overwritten.
#
# The set should keep a spread of the twelve kinds and the awkward cases the
# phase-3 demo names: news, a recipe, a video, a repository, a shop page, a
# paywalled article, a non-English page, a PDF link.

go-blog-go122       https://go.dev/blog/go1.22
wikipedia-sourdough https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sourdough
github-go-sqlite    https://github.com/glebarez/go-sqlite
